name: Late-Thrust Duelist

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The duelist makes three attacks, using Estoc or Iron Bolt in any combination.

Actions.name: Estoc
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. 28 (5d8 + 6) Piercing damage.

Actions.name: Iron Bolt
Actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +10, range 80/320 ft. 24 (4d8 + 6) Piercing damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Umbral Step
Bonus Actions.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the duelist takes the Hide action.

Reactions.name: Riposte
Reactions.text: *Trigger:* A creature within 5 feet of the duelist misses it with a melee attack roll. *Response:* The duelist makes one Estoc attack against that creature.
Reactions.gmQuote: a duellist who only ever makes one attack and it always lands

Traits.name: Woven Shadow
Traits.text: While the duelist is in Dim Light or Darkness, attack rolls against the duelist have Disadvantage, and each of the duelist's turns it makes only one attack, which automatically hits its chosen target.
Traits.clause: The duelist's body is woven of its own shadow; while it remains in Dim Light or Darkness, its outline dissolves into the
Traits.expresses: the one perfect thrust that always lands
Traits.expressedQuote: each of the duelist's turns it makes only one attack, which automatically hits its chosen target

lore: A soul that lost one duel too many, remade by the shadow of its own blade into an unseen killer condemned to win forever the single thrust it once threw too late.

generation.userConcept: a duellist who only ever makes one attack, and it always lands
generation.cite: composition after Assassin (CR 8) — the rider-heavy burst and the expertise Stealth
